sections.title: Local control room for your software projects.
sections.lede: Bring an ordinary Git repository. Keep the tools and remotes you already use.

items.title: Project Registry
items.body: Bind canonical repository roots, working trees, and target identities to explicit validation maps before running checks.

items.title: Isolated Runroom
items.body: Build and test in bounded local checkouts with step-by-step log capture and execution cancellation.
items.note: Runroom protects your main working tree; it is not an OS security sandbox.

items.title: Proof Ledger
items.body: Save cryptographic, ECDSA P-256 signed run records binding source commit SHAs, test outcomes, and build digests.
items.note: Local signatures verify payload integrity against local keys, not third-party issuer trust.

items.title: Recovery Vault
items.body: Prepare recovery bundles with explicitly recorded contents and rehearse restoration into a separate location.
